metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 TransitGatewayRouting activity
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
  let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
  [
    "AcceptTransitGatewayMulticastDomainAssociations", "Execute", "Transit Gateway Attachment",
    "AssociateTransitGatewayMulticastDomain", "Set", "Transit Gateway Multicast Domain",
    "AssociateTransitGatewayPolicyTable", "Set", "Transit Gateway Policy Table",
    "AssociateTransitGatewayRouteTable", "Set", "Transit Gateway Route Table",
    "CreateTransitGatewayMeteringPolicy", "Create", "Transit Gateway Metering Policy",
    "CreateTransitGatewayMeteringPolicyEntry", "Create", "Transit Gateway Metering Policy Entry",
    "CreateTransitGatewayMulticastDomain", "Create", "Transit Gateway Multicast Domain",
    "CreateTransitGatewayPolicyTable", "Create", "Transit Gateway Policy Table",
    "CreateTransitGatewayPolicyTableEntry", "Create", "Transit Gateway Policy Table Entry",
    "CreateTransitGatewayPrefixListReference", "Create", "Transit Gateway Prefix List Reference",
    "CreateTransitGatewayRoute", "Create", "Transit Gateway Route Table",
    "CreateTransitGatewayRouteTable", "Create", "Transit Gateway Route Table",
    "CreateTransitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncement", "Create", "Transit Gateway Route Table Announcement",
    "DeleteTransitGatewayMeteringPolicy", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Metering Policy",
    "DeleteTransitGatewayMeteringPolicyEntry", "Set", "Transit Gateway Metering Policy",
    "DeleteTransitGatewayMulticastDomain", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Multicast Domain",
    "DeleteTransitGatewayPolicyTable", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Policy Table",
    "DeleteTransitGatewayPolicyTableEntry", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Policy Table Entry",
    "DeleteTransitGatewayPrefixListReference", "Set", "Transit Gateway Route Table",
    "DeleteTransitGatewayRoute", "Set", "Transit Gateway Route Table",
    "DeleteTransitGatewayRouteTable", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Route Table",
    "DeleteTransitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncement", "Execute", "Transit Gateway Route Table Announcement",
    "DeregisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupMembers", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Multicast Domain",
    "DeregisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupSources", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Multicast Domain",
    "DescribeTransitGatewayMulticastDomains", "Read", "Transit Gateway Multicast Domain",
    "DescribeTransitGatewayPolicyTables", "Read", "Transit Gateway Policy Table",
    "DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncements", "Read", "Transit Gateway Route Table Announcement",
    "DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables", "Read", "Transit Gateway Route Table",
    "DisableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation", "Disable", "Transit Gateway Route Table",
    "DisassociateTransitGatewayMulticastDomain", "Set", "Transit Gateway Multicast Domain",
    "DisassociateTransitGatewayPolicyTable", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Policy Table",
    "DisassociateTransitGatewayRouteTable", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Route Table",
    "EnableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation", "Enable", "Transit Gateway Table Propagation",
    "ExportTransitGatewayRoutes", "Execute", "Transit Gateway Route Table",
    "GetTransitGatewayAttachmentPropagations", "Read", "Transit Gateway Attachment",
    "GetTransitGatewayMeteringPolicyEntries", "Read", "Transit Gateway Petering Policy",
    "GetTransitGatewayMulticastDomainAssociations", "Read", "Transit Gateway Multicast Domain",
    "GetTransitGatewayPolicyTableAssociations", "Read", "Transit Gateway Policy Table",
    "GetTransitGatewayPolicyTableEntries", "Read", "Transit Gateway Policy Table",
    "GetTransitGatewayPrefixListReferences", "Read", "Transit Gateway Policy Table",
    "GetTransitGatewayRouteTableAssociations", "Read", "Transit Gateway Policy Table",
    "GetTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagations", "Read", "Transit Gateway Policy Table",
    "ModifyTransitGatewayMeteringPolicy", "Set", "Transit Gateway Metering Policy",
    "ModifyTransitGatewayPolicyTableEntry", "Set", "Transit Gateway Policy Table Entry",
    "ModifyTransitGatewayPrefixListReference", "Set", "Transit Gateway Prefix List Reference",
    "RegisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupMembers", "Set", "Transit Gateway Multicast Domain",
    "RegisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupSources", "Create", "Transit Gateway Multicast Group Source",
    "RejectTransitGatewayMulticastDomainAssociations", "Execute", "Transit Gateway Multicast Domain",
    "ReplaceTransitGatewayRoute", "Set", "Transit Gateway Route Table",
    "SearchTransitGatewayMulticastGroups", "Read", "Transit Gateway Multicast Group",
    "SearchTransitGatewayRoutes", "Read", "Transit Gateway Route Table"
  ];
  AWSCloudTrail
  | where not(disabled)
  | where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
  | where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
  | lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
  | extend RequestParameters = todynamic(RequestParameters), ResponseElements = todynamic(ResponseElements)
  | extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
  | extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
      EventName in ("AcceptTransitGatewayMulticastDomainAssociations", "AssociateTransitGatewayMulticastDomain",
        "RejectTransitGatewayMulticastDomainAssociations"), ResponseElements.associations,
      EventName in ("AssociateTransitGatewayPolicyTable", "AssociateTransitGatewayRouteTable"),
        ResponseElements.association,
      EventName in ("CreateTransitGatewayMeteringPolicy", "ModifyTransitGatewayMeteringPolicy"),
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayMeteringPolicy,
      EventName in ("CreateTransitGatewayMeteringPolicyEntry", "DeleteTransitGatewayMeteringPolicyEntry"),
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayMeteringPolicyEntry,
      EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayMulticastDomain", ResponseElements.transitGatewayMulticastDomain,
      EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayPolicyTable", ResponseElements.transitGatewayPolicyTable,
      EventName in ("CreateTransitGatewayPolicyTableEntry", "ModifyTransitGatewayPolicyTableEntry"),
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayPolicyTableEntry,
      EventName in ("CreateTransitGatewayPrefixListReference", "DeleteTransitGatewayPrefixListReference",
        "ModifyTransitGatewayPrefixListReference"), ResponseElements.transitGatewayPrefixListReference,
      EventName in ("CreateTransitGatewayRoute", "DeleteTransitGatewayRoute"), ResponseElements.route,
      EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayRouteTable", ResponseElements.transitGatewayRouteTable,
      EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncement",
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncement,
      EventName == "DeregisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupMembers",
        ResponseElements.deregisteredMulticastGroupMembers,
      EventName == "DeregisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupSources",
        ResponseElements.deregisteredMulticastGroupSources,
      EventName == "EnableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation", ResponseElements.propagation,
      EventName == "ExportTransitGatewayRoutes", ResponseElements.s3Location,
      EventName == "RegisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupMembers",
        ResponseElements.registeredMulticastGroupMembers,
      EventName == "RegisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupSources",
        ResponseElements.registeredMulticastGroupSources,
      ""
    ), "")
  | extend ObjectId = case(
      EventName in ("AcceptTransitGatewayMulticastDomainAssociations",
        "EnableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation", "GetTransitGatewayAttachmentPropagations"),
        RequestParameters.TransitGatewayAttachmentId,
      EventName in ("AssociateTransitGatewayMulticastDomain", "DeleteTransitGatewayMulticastDomain",
        "DeregisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupMembers", "DeregisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupSources",
        "DisassociateTransitGatewayMulticastDomain", "GetTransitGatewayMulticastDomainAssociations",
        "RegisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupMembers", "RegisterTransitGatewayMulticastGroupSources",
        "RejectTransitGatewayMulticastDomainAssociations", "SearchTransitGatewayMulticastGroups"),
        RequestParameters.TransitGatewayMulticastDomainId,
      EventName in ("AssociateTransitGatewayPolicyTable", "DeleteTransitGatewayPolicyTable",
        "DeleteTransitGatewayPrefixListReference", "DisassociateTransitGatewayPolicyTable",
        "GetTransitGatewayPolicyTableAssociations", "GetTransitGatewayPolicyTableEntries"),
        RequestParameters.TransitGatewayPolicyTableId,
      EventName in ("AssociateTransitGatewayRouteTable", "CreateTransitGatewayRoute",
        "DeleteTransitGatewayRoute", "DeleteTransitGatewayRouteTable",
        "DisableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation", "DisassociateTransitGatewayRouteTable",
        "ExportTransitGatewayRoutes", "GetTransitGatewayPrefixListReferences",
        "GetTransitGatewayRouteTableAssociations", "GetTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagations",
        "ReplaceTransitGatewayRoute", "SearchTransitGatewayRoutes"),
        RequestParameters.TransitGatewayRouteTableId,
      EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayMeteringPolicy",
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayMeteringPolicy.transitGatewayMeteringPolicyId,
      EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayMeteringPolicyEntry",
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayMeteringPolicyEntry.transitGatewayMeteringPolicyEntryId,
      EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayMulticastDomain",
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayMulticastDomain.transitGatewayId,
      EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayPolicyTable",
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayPolicyTable.transitGatewayPolicyTableId,
      EventName in ("CreateTransitGatewayPolicyTableEntry", "DeleteTransitGatewayPolicyTableEntry",
        "ModifyTransitGatewayPolicyTableEntry"),
        iff(isnotempty(coalesce(RequestParameters.transitGatewayPolicyTableId,
        RequestParameters.TransitGatewayPolicyTableId)) and
        isnotempty(coalesce(RequestParameters.policyRuleNumber, RequestParameters.PolicyRuleNumber)),
        strcat(coalesce(RequestParameters.transitGatewayPolicyTableId,
        RequestParameters.TransitGatewayPolicyTableId), ":", coalesce(RequestParameters.policyRuleNumber,
        RequestParameters.PolicyRuleNumber)), ""),
      EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayPrefixListReference",
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayPrefixListReference.transitGatewayRouteTableId,
      EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayRouteTable",
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayRouteTable.transitGatewayRouteTableId,
      EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncement",
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncement.transitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncementId,
      EventName in ("DeleteTransitGatewayMeteringPolicy", "DeleteTransitGatewayMeteringPolicyEntry",
        "GetTransitGatewayMeteringPolicyEntries", "ModifyTransitGatewayMeteringPolicy"),
        RequestParameters.TransitGatewayMeteringPolicyId,
      EventName == "DeleteTransitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncement",
        RequestParameters.TransitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncementId,
      EventName == "DescribeTransitGatewayMulticastDomains", RequestParameters.TransitGatewayAttachmentIds,
      EventName == "DescribeTransitGatewayPolicyTables", RequestParameters.TransitGatewayPolicyTableIds,
      EventName == "DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncements",
        RequestParameters.TransitGatewayRouteTableAnnouncementIds,
      EventName == "DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables", RequestParameters.TransitGatewayRouteTableIds,
      EventName == "ModifyTransitGatewayPrefixListReference",
        ResponseElements.transitGatewayPrefixListReference.prefixListId,
      ""
    )
  | extend
      Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventSeverity = "Informational",
      EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventVendor = "AWS",
      EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
      Dvc = "CloudTrail",
      EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
      ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
      TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
      TargetAppType = "Service"
  | project-rename
      EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
      EventOriginalType = EventName,
      EventUid = AwsEventId,
      EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
      EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
      ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
      ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
      ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
      HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
  | extend
      ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
      ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
      SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
      ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
      ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
      ActorUserEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
      TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
      TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
  | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
      "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
      "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
      "APIVersion", APIVersion,
      "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
      "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
      "RequestParameters", RequestParameters,
      "ResponseElements", ResponseElements
    ), dynamic({}))
  | extend
      Operation = EventOriginalType,
      User = ActorUsername,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      Application = TargetAppName,
      Value = NewValue
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
      EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
      EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
      ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
      SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
      Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
      ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
      AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
      TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
